borrowed_services.identity: All accessors refer to existing application-owned cells and contexts; no alias cell, owner, manager, provider, allocator or callback family is created.

lifetime: Borrowed contexts and cells remain alive through the existing shared singleton drain and immediate VFS retirement. F8D31C bits remain after owner deletion and may then be dangling; this packet never dereferences them after drain.

validation.seed_verification: 8 of 8 native differential seed bodies matched the installed executable

limits: No GameNativeParticleRuntime construction, registration, dispatch or install.
No raw resource manager/load cache, texture cache, render owners, F8D344 parameter pool, particle cache, atlas manager, platform host or load-event host is supplied.
GameResourceManager and GuiLuaRef are not substituted for native raw owners.
No native ABI, FH3, renderer, gameplay or installed-game runtime validation.
